in_marathi.name: Ridhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ridhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ridhi means one who has wealth and prosperity. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Riddhi’ which means wealth and prosperity. The name is believed to bring good fortune and abundance in life.

vedic_reference.note: Ridhi is a form of the Goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. She is described as the one who is always accompanied by prosperity and who bestows it upon her devotees.
